title: Hide and Seek
tagline: One of you is it. Two of them are worse.
description: Online multiplayer hide and seek across four locations — The Grand Hotel, Cinder Mall, Mercy Hospital, and Crowne Point Cinema — each stalked by its own roster of demons. One player is the seeker, held back at the start while everyone else scatters; the demons hunt everyone, seeker included, so being it is not safe either. Crouch to stay hidden, spend your flashlight battery carefully, and keep moving: standing still too long brings a demon to your room. Two to eight guests on a server-authoritative round, or a solo run against the CPU. Only the hotel and Cinder Mall have been playtested with real people so far.
status: Playable - solo and online 2-8 players, server authoritative
